dict.După fiecare termen scrie data următorul: After each hearing, enter the date of the next one; a past date left unchanged shows "To update" (in red).
dict.La Închis = Da dosarul nu mai intră la c: With Closed = Yes the case no longer counts as active; under To prepare list the documents, witnesses or court fee.
dict.Pentru avocați, consilieri juridici și f: For lawyers, legal advisers and companies with lawsuits: each case with its number, court, client, opposing party, subject matter, stage and next hearing, with the time and what to prepare; you get the days until the hearing and the status: within 7 days (in yellow), to update after a past hearing (in red), in progress (in green), no hearing set or closed; on the right the active cases and the next hearing, with its court.
